english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the beginning or starting point of something.
Use 起點 when “start” means a marked point in a race, route, or game.

examples.english: This is the origin of our journey.
examples.traditional: 呢度係我哋旅程嘅起點。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 leoi5 cing4 ge3 hei2 dim2

examples.english: This is the start of the race track.
examples.jyutping: ni1 dou6 hai6 tiu4 coi3 dou6 ge3 hei2 dim2
